title: I124: the post-derive crashes (HUMAN_ANSWERS Q106, the lead's ruling): three fail-closed instrument defects I120 measured once every stage reads the whole document, each fixed from the semantics. F-M6-06: goloop's counter-proof builder wrote the empty cell sequence (the one value of a carrier of zero cells) by indexing an empty list; it is Bend's []. F-M6-07 (a resource limit, not a generator defect: HUMAN_ANSWERS Q108): a compile that fails for any recorded cause stopped the DISCH runner; the error now names its cause (exit code, signal or time-out), and under the runner's --section-errors unknown (I112's opt-in) a compile that fails for any recorded cause confines its failure to its document: its laws UNKNOWN with the cause, every other document decided as before; without the opt-in nothing changes, and no generator changes. F-M6-08: bind refused the whole milestone when a law's model had never been generated by the run; such a law is now unbound with that reason, every other law bound as before. Measured on the base after I122's and I123's landings, base code against this key's code, on one protocol

thresholds.doc: No number is a gate (BUILD_PLAN §4, M6 exit). Each prediction holds or misses as stated; a miss is reported, never forced. P1-P9 are on planted fixtures written from Go's and Bend's semantics (tests_m6/fixtures/i124: the package latch for F-M6-06 and F-M6-08, the Go machines till for F-M6-07) and are the evidence that each fix is correct; each was run on the base before this prereg and reproduces its crash there (IndexError in cells_literal; the DISCH runner stopped by EvalError; bind exit 1, nothing written). P10-P12 are smoke on contaminated data (Q98): I51's corpus is unsealed and contaminated by I51, I103-I123 and I107, so they measure how much the change restores, never generality, which is claimed only from I114's sealed pair. P13 is Morph's record. Laws are reported as aggregates only, never splitting PROVED from REFUTED (Q56, Q89); stage reasons only for stages before any decision (Q72): the runner and bind commit aggregates only, and the crash classes are counted from the vault's runner outputs, reported as counts. Units are invariant (Q69): counts of entries, runners, documents and laws.
thresholds.instruments: holon.gen.goloop.cells_literal (F-M6-06); holon.sorts.evaluate3.compile_failure and holon.disch.run.Run.section_error (F-M6-07); holon.bindings.bind_law (F-M6-08); tests_m6/test_i124_post_derive_crashes.py (every check). The planted runs use I117's landed protocol (spec/M6/lib/i117_run.json: no run or bind fallback, so a crash is seen as the crash it is) for P2, P3 and P7-P9, and I112's protocol (spec/M6/lib/i112_run.json: disch.section_errors "unknown") for P5 and P6, where the planted fault (a time-out of the real checker, set on the fixture's own run for one document's model only, in the scratch root) is the deterministic recorded cause Q108 asks for. This key adds no protocol of its own: a crash fix changes the default path (Q106 (4)).
thresholds.base: Built on the lead at e3be9798 (I118's landing). Q106 (4): the measured runs sit on the lead after I122's and I123's landings (and I121's, if it lands in between), merged into this branch by a merge commit when the coordinator names it, with Q104's combined base protocol spec/M6/lib/base_run.json as the lead regenerates it there; the merge sha and the protocol's sha256 are recorded in the report.
thresholds.counting: Q104 (2), adapted to a default-path change: two runs of holon eval holon --protocol spec/M6/lib/base_run.json --compose over the corpus on the named base, with --vault outside the repository. The baseline: the base code (the merge's first parent, this key's holon/ changes absent) into results/M6/I124/base/. The counted run (Q80): this key's code into results/M6/I124/holon/. Each is the first such run that finishes; a re-run counts only if the first never finished, any other is reported beside it as not counted; no started run's output is ever deleted (Q76). The preflight (I112's plus Q87's go pins) must pass before each. A committed baseline of another key is cited only where its code, targets, holon_sha256 and protocol sha256 all match exactly.
thresholds.soundness: No change makes a law PROVED that was not: (06) the empty list is the exact term for the only value of a zero-cell carrier, and every decision is still a counter-law Bend accepts, its witness replayed on the real Go code (P2); a law Bend rejects at that witness stays UNKNOWN (P2's true law). (07) a document whose model cannot be built is decided by nothing: its laws are UNKNOWN with the error, no proof or search is attempted, and the other documents run exactly as they would (P5); the change only turns a runner stop into per-document UNKNOWNs, under an opt-in that already does so for refused sections. (08) a law whose model was never generated has no record that the run decided (the runner writes the model before it decides any law over it), and the binding check refuses any decided record of an unbound law (P8); every bound law is bound exactly as before (P7). Every REFUTED still needs its replay.
thresholds.amendment_to_brief: HUMAN_ANSWERS Q108 (the lead, relayed before this commit): F-M6-07 as filed (a generator emitting code its checker rejects) does not reproduce: the generated model is one Bend accepts (exit 0 on the same bytes in this key's sandbox), and the failure is a resource limit (the compile peaks near 11.7 GB RSS on a 15 GB container). Its fix is (a)-(b) as approved, not a generator change; a resource kill depends on the environment, so the record always names its cause. Q108 (4): the preflight memory record (MemTotal, MemAvailable, the container limit) is not added by this key; it stays the ledger entry F-M6-11 for a later key.

predictions.claim: (F-M6-06, unit) cells_literal of the empty sequence is "[]"; every non-empty sequence is written byte for byte as before I124 (a copy of the old algorithm).

(F-M6-06, planted) Latch's ops all have a cell map of zero cells. Under the fix the milestone runner finishes with every law recorded; the totality law of Trip, the weak law and the domain law over Rest and Trip are REFUTED through Bend at the empty carrier, and replayed on the real Go code (Trip panics, Rest returns nil) with the records' differences; the totality law of Rest (true) and of Valve's Shut are UNKNOWN, Bend rejecting every counter-proof of Rest's. On the base the runner raises IndexError and these laws have no record.
(F-M6-06, just outside) Stale (a field loaded after a store) is outside the model class: its laws are UNKNOWN with a reason, as before.
(F-M6-07, unit) a failed compile names its cause: time-out, the signal that ended the checker, the exit code, or exit 0 with no module written.

(F-M6-07, planted) Till and Drawer, with Drawer's typed-model compile run by the real checker under a time-out it cannot meet (a deterministic recorded cause, Q108): the DISCH runner finishes; Drawer's DISCH laws (decided without the fault) are UNKNOWN with one section attempt whose error says the model could not be built and that the checker timed out; every other record is byte for byte the same as without the fault, at least one decided. On the base the runner stops and no DISCH law has a record.
(F-M6-07, outside the opt-in) without --section-errors unknown the same fault stops the runner as before: no DISCH law has a record.

(F-M6-08, planted) the milestone runner run over Latch's laws only (Valve's model never generated), then holon bind --unbound skip: bind finishes; every Latch law is bound, byte for byte as the full run binds it; every Valve law is unbound with the reason that its model was not generated. On the base bind exits 1 and writes nothing.
(F-M6-08, soundness) a planted REFUTED record for Valve's unbound law is refused by the binding check (rewritten UNKNOWN); Latch's decided records are admitted.
(F-M6-08, just outside) a law whose facts document is missing is not a model the run never generated: bind --unbound skip still refuses (exit 1, nothing written).

(Corpus, smoke on contaminated data) On the base, crashes of the three classes on the entries I120 named (c04, c09, c14, c19), counted from the vault's runner outputs (F-M6-07's is environment-dependent and may not recur). Under the fix: none of the three classes on any entry; on c04, c09, c14 and c19 every runner exits 0 and bind exits 0.
(Corpus, smoke) Under the fix every law of c04, c09, c14 and c19 that reaches a runner has a record (the run stage's "0 laws with no record").
(Corpus, smoke) The decided count (PROVED and REFUTED together, Q56) under the fix is at least the base's and at least 1. Every decided law is handled under Q56 from the vault.

Morph's M0-M3 move only by re-stamp: holon land dirty re-makes no law; gate-M0 passes; gate-M1 and gate-M2 pass, or fail on G1's generator_sha256 alone; gate-M3 partial passes. The change sits in generator closures (holon/gen/goloop.py, holon/sorts/evaluate3.py, holon/disch/run.py, holon/bindings.py), so the PR carries the re-stamp plan.
